description: This file defines the Configuration class for AWS SDK's S3 regional endpoint handling, managing endpoint types and fallback options.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Handles configuration for AWS S3 regional endpoints, including endpoint type and fallback options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Configuration with a specified endpoint type and fallback flag, validating the endpoint type.

methods.name: getEndpointsType
methods.description: Returns the type of endpoints ('legacy' or 'regional').

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.

methods.name: isFallback
methods.description: Indicates if fallback is enabled for this configuration.
